crossRefs.note: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of king David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary, which he…
We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people.…

translations.web: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.
translations.bsb: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Seeing that he gave his hand in pledge yet did all these things, he will not escape!’
translations.kjv: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
translations.asv: For he hath despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet hath done all these things; he shall not escape.
